decisions.reason: The change from 180 to 140 monthly approved clips concerns ongoing production output, not the separate task-local trial batch requirement.
The monthly quota and approval authority do not change the permitted source collection, topic constraint, source exclusions, or trial batch source rule.
The dedicated Instagram account setup is independently introduced by the same message and remains unchanged by the monthly output adjustment.
Requiring personal approval for quota counting does not modify the existing good-hook selection criterion.
The tracking metrics, applicability to posted clips, and transparency are independently introduced by the same message and are not altered by the quota change.
The source reiterates that quality affects approval but does not change the clean editing standard or prohibited visual treatments.
The monthly approved-clip quota does not modify the requirement to select moments that teach something or provide meaningful value.
The source does not change the completeness or standalone-understandability standards for clips.
Personal approval and the revised monthly quota do not alter the white-text-only or no-text-effects rules.
The source does not modify the requirement to use the exact font specified in the brand guidelines.
The change in monthly approved-clip volume and approval authority does not alter the 20-to-120-second duration bounds.
